markers.description: homonym number (distinguishes identical headwords, printed as Roman numerals I, II)
variant form (phonetic variant listed after a comma alongside the headword)
subentry (derived form or phrase bolded within the main entry)
sense number (Arabic numerals marking multiple meanings)
usage note or restriction (parenthetical Russian context in italics)
plural form (vernacular plural printed in brackets with мн.)

rules: Homonyms: Separate \lx blocks with the same lemma, each receiving a \hm number (1, 2 printing as I, II).
Sub-entries: Run-on \se sub-lemma followed by \gn ... inside the same record block, separated from the main entry by a semicolon.
Multiple glosses: Close Russian synonyms are separated by commas; distant meanings are separated by semicolons (if not split into numbered senses).
Usage notes: Parenthetical italicized Russian text providing semantic context or object restrictions goes into \un.
